goal.objective: Build an interactive reference human whose supported inputs propagate through connected organ, tissue, cellular, neural and selected molecular-reaction models, with consistent scale inspection and reproducible evidence.
goal.completionPolicy: Finish bounded releases only when all phase criteria have receipts. This roadmap does not define perfect or atomically complete human simulation as achievable.

execution.completedScope: P0 complete; P1 local physical mechanisms and source reproduction delivered; P2 muscle/fascicle/fiber/sarcomere visual prototype delivered, including manual filament sliding. Scientific and full phase gates remain open.
execution.note: Project goals in this file do not resume or replace the pre-existing paused execution goal.

goalCreationAttempt.objective: M1: complete P1-P4 with their required evidence

milestones.title: Meal to muscle across scales
milestones.demonstration: Defined meal -> glucose/insulin transport -> muscle exposure -> receptor signaling -> GLUT4/glucose uptake -> organ/systemic totals; compare receptor sensitivity while preserving state through zoom and replay.

milestones.title: Functional neural reflex and muscle response
milestones.demonstration: Sensory input -> spinal route -> NMJ -> calcium/force -> proprioceptive and metabolic feedback.

milestones.title: Brain circuit and local blood supply
milestones.demonstration: Selected sensory/central/motor activity -> local metabolic demand -> regional perfusion response.

milestones.title: Endocrine-organ feedback
milestones.demonstration: Liver/kidney/vessel/adrenal feedback and scoped endocrine axes with receptor-mediated effects.

milestones.title: Functional organ microstructures
milestones.demonstration: Individually validated organ units coupled to systemic transport and neural/endocrine regulation.

milestones.title: Integrated reference experiments
milestones.demonstration: Held-out whole-body perturbations with consistent cross-scale inspection and uncertainty.

milestones.title: Selected molecular refinement
milestones.demonstration: A detailed mechanism improves a held-out prediction at a declared computation cost.

phases.title: Baseline audit and execution plan
completionCriteria: Recomputed live anatomy assembly and physiological state inventories.
Inspected current endocrine, transport, neural proxy and display-motion boundaries.
Saved a bounded multiscale plan with phase gates and source candidates.

phases.title: Physical units, model ownership and scientific fixtures
completionCriteria: Species, compartment, reaction, port and evidence contracts reject unit or ownership errors.
An E01 ligand transport/binding fixture passes analytic and conservation checks.
A pinned published insulin-response model reproduces its reference experiment.
Independent validation endpoints and tolerances are specified before fitting.
Legacy relative signals and recordings remain explicitly versioned.

criterionProgress.evidence: Unit, ownership, port and moiety validation exercised by numerical tests.
E01 analytic fixtures, conservative transfers, binding equilibrium and causal controls pass.
Archived no-feedback pulse reproduced against independent Radau and BDF transcriptions at locked engineering tolerances.

Three human endpoints reviewed. AS160 and image-colocalization readouts do not map to existing states. Direct surface-GLUT4 assay is preferred for further review; donor data, observation mapping and bounds remain unresolved.
Molecular experiments and checkpoints have exact model/solver contracts; legacy whole-body recordings remain separate. Invalid imports preserve the current experiment.

phases.title: Blender pipeline and multiscale anatomy package
completionCriteria: A muscle/fascicle/capillary/cell package preserves entity IDs and physical scale through export.
A brain-region package records source space and registration status.
Measured and representative structures are distinguishable.
Runtime loading, cutaways, deformed picking and levels of detail pass inspection.
Source license, hashes, anatomy review and frame-time/memory receipts exist.
phases.dependencyNote: P1 physical-unit and identity contracts are implemented. Candidate asset work proceeds independently as allowed by plan section 6.2; human validation and full P1 completion remain open.

criterionProgress.evidence: Muscle/fascicle/fiber/capillary prototype exports meters and stable IDs in two LODs; source-to-microstructure registration and anatomical review remain open.
Brain region package not yet built.
Source surface versus representative geometry labeled in manifest and visible inspector.

2026-09-17: six tissue, three sarcomere and four circulation production browser checks pass. Manual filament translation, picking after movement, sections, LOD and replay are covered. Coupled force-driven deformation, anatomical review and hardware performance remain pending. Historical 23-test receipt belongs to the earlier package.
Source license, hashes and local software/browser checks exist; anatomical review and physical-device performance gates remain open.

phases.title: Circulation, blood chemistry and transported hormones
completionCriteria: A reviewed pilot vascular circuit has explicit ports and terminal beds.
Insulin has physical local concentration, transport, exchange and clearance.
Plasma/RBC and gas reference bases are explicit.
Pulsatile flow and gas-exchange fixtures pass conservation, convergence and reference comparisons.
Legacy coarse mechanisms cannot duplicate owned new fluxes.

phases.title: Insulin-muscle mechanism and coherent zoom
completionCriteria: A meal causes receptor-mediated muscle glucose uptake through the modeled route.
Normal and reduced sensitivity comparisons expose local and systemic causal effects.
Camera zoom leaves numerical results unchanged.
Fine-region replacement and aggregation conserve inventories and charge each flux once.
Pinned biological endpoints are evaluated and failures disclosed.
Export and resume preserve model, refinement, seed and parameter versions.

phases.title: Functional peripheral nervous system
completionCriteria: A reviewed stretch-reflex route connects receptor, afferent, spinal circuit, motor output and muscle.
Axon events, synaptic release, cleft clearance and receptor action determine response.
Muscle calcium, force, proprioception and energy demand form a coupled loop.
Reflex timing and perturbation effects are evaluated against selected data.
Cardiac autonomic targets have distinct receptors and evidence-linked routes.

phases.title: Registered brain, selected circuits and blood supply
completionCriteria: Brain regions and source transforms have registration and uncertainty receipts.
The 178 baseline vascular candidates have an evidence-preserving updated classification.
A selected sensory/central/motor circuit has declared connectivity and model provenance.
Neural demand drives a tested regional metabolic/perfusion response with systemic accounting.
Selected exchange/CSF boundaries and unresolved connectivity are explicit.
Species and inference labels remain attached to cells and connections.

phases.title: Endocrine and organ feedback expansion
completionCriteria: RAAS/aldosterone, ADH and counterregulation have explicit local transport/receptor effects.
HPA, thyroid, GH/IGF and calcium modules each have scoped evidence and tests.
All 31 legacy endocrine signals have causal, descriptive or unresolved status.
Digestive ducts and renal transport follow their correct physical routes.
Feedback delay, sensitivity and source-specific perturbations have receipts.

phases.title: Organ functional units and blood-cell detail
completionCriteria: Liver, nephron, alveolar, intestinal, islet, cardiac and skin units each have an individual receipt.
Blood-cell and glial detail is limited to named mechanisms with supporting evidence.
Fine-unit boundary fluxes aggregate consistently into the body.
Every unit passes its own reference experiments and whole-body regressions.
Units without accepted evidence remain coarse and cannot count as completed.

phases.title: Integrated sensory and whole-body experiment suite
completionCriteria: Supported food, air, sensory and environmental inputs have explicit receptor-to-effector paths.
Held-out meal/exercise/recovery and fluid scenarios are evaluated.
Uncertainty, parameter identifiability and model domain are reported.
Supported-duration stability, replay, browser behavior and runtime budgets pass.
Coverage report distinguishes anatomical, numerical and biological evidence.

phases.title: Selected molecular and individual refinement
completionCriteria: One selected detailed molecular or reaction-diffusion mechanism improves a predeclared held-out prediction.
Coarse/fine agreement is demonstrated in the supported domain.
Stochastic patches or offline atomistic work have explicit questions and compute budgets.
Any individual fitting has identifiable parameters and appropriate measurements.
No milestone claims every molecule or universal human completeness.

experiments.note: Physical amount and concentration checks, analytic clearance/mixing/binding, conservation and causal controls pass. This is numerical verification, not human biological validation.
